title: Ki Saimuka Na Diengkynthong (Threads of Memory)
author: Firmly Star Lyngdoh
description: Rich oral narratives, cultural tales, and historical clan legends collected from the ancestral village of Diengkynthong.

KSHAID UMDONG
Ko Ksbaid Umdong arkhap Mawsiang,
Rymphai phi noh liuh khlieh phi phriang;
Shathie sha tbian la khlieh phi sum,
Na ar kyrdan sha pung ba jngum.
Katba rymphai la khlieh phi noh,
Ki sur bathiang ki sohtyngkoh;
Painkhar narud ia phi u jngoh,
U Jamalang u kjor u khroh.
La khlieh kyrngeh ki ia pynnoh,
Katba ki sur my Hung ki shoh;
Wat Tiew Laphiah napoh sangara,
Na khap ki fluit u shoh saham.
Baroh sha phi la khmat kynriang.
Ban sngap ruh ia ki sur bathiang;
Ki sim, ki doh ki mrad ki mreng,
Hajan jong phi ki shad ki kmen.
Ki fiat ki ram, ki khlaw ki btap,

Ki sngewthiang ki shlei ki dap;
Baroh ki kynud sur ba bang,
Ha lum ha wah, ha them ha phlang.
Syntiew ki skud, jingthung jingtep,
Phi ktik ruh ia mynsiem Nongrep;
Ki plung ki mer hajan joog phi,
Ryngkat ki sur ka dong bisli.
Shisien ba ki la poi sha phi,
Kim lah khlem mad shi kyndup kti:
Kim lah khlem shong khlem da pyrkhat,,
Jingitynnad ba pynshoh khmat.
Nangta pat thiaw shu ngai-ly-ngai,
Napoh syrngiew ki dieng Jakrai;
Sha krom sha kroh, sha thiiew sha syar.
Jar jar phi tuid jar jar phi par.
Khatduh phi poi shaduh Umiam,
la phi de bak ka kit ka lam ;
Ryngkat bad ka, phi shad phi kmen,
Ha ban da poi ri thor phi Ingen.
KA MAWJRONG
Hangne Mot bah bad Mawbynna
Ki dang lai sah haduh mynta;
Ba kumta da ka jingsarong,
Kane ka shnong la jer Mawjrong.
Mawjrong ka dei ruh te ka shnong,
B la seng ruh da u Ni u Kong;
Matti jong ki dang i shynna,
Kum Mot, Mawshieng bad Mawbynna.
Kine kynjreng ki dang ieng skhem.
Ban sah ka nara ban sah kyrieng,
Namar ka Ri bad jait bynriew,
la la wei jong ki ban kyrsiew.
Dicn jat jong ki, to ngin pyrlhuh,
Jingtei jong ki ban ym pynduh;
Ngin ri suniar ia ki kyndong,

Namar jong ki ngin sngewsarong.
Jingdon jong ki pynphuh pynphieng,
la la ka Ri ban pynsynkhien;
Sha jrong ki rah i'a nam jong ka,
Kumba la seng d u Ni d u kpa.
Hei ! Paid ka ri kylleng sawdong,
Matti longshuwa da kynmaw dngong;
Jingtei jong ki wat nym pynmong,
Namar jong ki burom ngin phong.
KA LAITKROH
Ha sngap ha sngew ha phi baroh,
Ngan thuhkhana la ka Laitkroh ;
Ka dei kyrteng kawei ka shnong,
Ba don shathie na sor Shillong.
Balei la khot kumtei i'a ka,
Naduh ki sngi ba mynshuwa;
Ka daw ka long kumne hana,
Ngan sdang ruh ka iathuhkhana.
Shisien la don kawei ka tymmen,
Kaba shong shnong ha Wah 5Jianglcng;
Ryngkat bad la ki khun ki kti,
Ka irn da rep bad ri jingri.
Hadicn ynda rep kam long shuh.
Bad piilang jingri ruh la kyrduh;
Davvei jingmut baroh ki ong :
Ya ngiu sliong noh shatei slia jrong.
Kumta ki sdang ban kynriah noh,
Ryngkat ruh bad jingri baroh;
Vii thiep ki kiew beit beit sha jrong,
Napoh lawbah lynti ki prong.
Katba dang laid kumne hapoh,
Ki shorn pynban da krem da kioh;
Kumta ki hap ban laid shitom,
Lyngba jingeh ban tur ban thorn.
Hynrci ynda la lait shalor,
Ki shem kyrhai pyntha kordor;
Kumta la ki pyntha baroh,

Ki jer kyrteng da ka Laitkroh.
Namar la lait na krem na kroh.
Bad jingshitom jingeh baroh;
Nangta ki shna ling kham paka.
Ban shong ban sah baroh shi arta.
Nangta ka crei ka ktah ki sdang,
Ka sniang ka syiar masi ka blang,
Parum pareh sha khlaw sha shnong,
Jingkmen sadhai ka ker sawdong.
NGA LONG U KHUN NONGREP
Nga long u khun nongrep,
Ha la i nongkyndong ;
Ki kam ngam bit ban pep,
Ngan trei nadong shadong.
Ki sngi tafew ki bnai —
Bad snem ki march stet —
Khlem lap sngewthuh la wai.
La poi por thung por tep.
Baroh ki saw samoi,
Nga trei shitom hi thait ;
Khnang ba ngan dup myntoi,
Kumtangamju shong thait;
Naduh dang step phyrngap,
Haduh dalongreifi ngaiil;
La thait la thngao hap hap,
Marwei nga puh nga daifi.
Ha nga ym don shuti,
Ha nga ym don shongthait ;
Sha lyngkha man ka sngi,
Nga leit ban prat ban mait.
Ka riam ka belt ngam da —
Salia, iwei patlun —
Sopti bad jaifi ban klum —
Na jingkhriat ban ia da.
Wat la nga riam tyrphut,
Wat la nga bam da shriew;
Mynsiem pynban ka suk,
Ngam dei u shakri briew.
Nga long shakri, nga long —
Kynrad, ha la i rympei,
Ym don ba lah la mon —

Ban pyndem da lei lei.
KA SHNONG JONG NGA
Ko shnong jong nga ba nga ieit eh
Ko shnong kaba la pynsan pynheh ;
Naduh dang rit pha kdup pha ri.
Ban plung ban mer ha la ka sngi.
Ko shnong jong ki syntiew ki skud,
Ko shnong ki dieng ko shnong ki siej ;
U ngap u Iwai ba fai kynud,
la Dongjngohkai ban pynshoh bieit.
Ki Iyer pyngngad ki bch jem jai,
Ki uni ba shngiam ruh ki kyrsoi;
Ka shnong ka thaw pahuh de hai
Ha baroh te ki saw samoi.
Pha plie ka lad pha plie lynti.
Ban lait na kyrduh ba hiran;
Ban suk ban saifi ki khun ki kti.
Ban foh ka bam ka dih ba biang.
Pham ju fliewbeifl i u rit i u ria,
Lymne iaba duk ne riewspah;
Pham mon ruh ba kin ia makia.
Hynrei bad pha ban shong ban sah.
Na pha la mih ki 'rang bad thei —
Kynsai, b la pynbna nam kylleng;
Ym don na ki b la shu sep ei,
Khlem da rah Tla nam bad kyrteng.
Pham ju shah ruh ia ki lili —
Pen pen ban wan rich tngen ha pha;
Namar pham kwah ban pyniewJi,
la la jinglong sotti nylla.
Kumta baroh kat kiba shong —
Ha pha, dei kiba smat ba sting;

Ban shong lali ruh te kim mon,
Ki trei ki ktah naphang hi lin.
Ki khun ba sting ka metka phad,
Ki dang lai mih ruh tang na pha;
Ki bym ju mon ban shong thad lad,
Namar jong pha ko shnong jong nga.
KA SHLEM
Ka Shlem ka dei te ka jaka,
Kaba baroh tiar nar la shna;
Kum wait, tari lane mohkhiew,
Ha dur ba pher ba kwah u briew.
I u nar khlem dur hangne la shna,
Ha dur itynnat bad paka;
Katba dang saw haia haih u nar.
La. tangoD stet bad dar bad dar.
La saiil la shoh halor u Rniang,
La pynwan dur ruh biang pa biang ;
Khnangba ki tiar kin long ba bha.
Bad kin trei kam baroh shirta.
Lane ruh khnangba kin kham neh,
la ki ha um la phrang pyneh ;
Jingphrang kam mut tang la kata,
Hynrei ban tip i u nar ba bha.
Kumta dei tang lyngba ka Shlem,
Ryngkat ruh bad ka ding ba ryhem;
I u nar ba kdor lab ban pynbeit,
Shi khyllipmat bym kynmaw peit.
Sarang baroh bangta ka hap,
Isbad paka hangne la lap;
Lane ia u ba luiS la pynnep.
Da jingsani la trei pyndep.
Kumta te baroh ruh ki tiar,
Kiba la mih napoh ka Shlem;
Ki dei ruh kiba la paka,

Kumta ym don ba lah ban len.
TIEW LANGKATI.
Hapdeng ki fluit marwei u long —
Tiew Langkati ba iwbih thiang.
Da kumno te sha u ngan thorn,
L ngba kine ki hiut ba jrong.
Jar jar u mih hapoh ki hint.
Jar jar ruh uphuh syntiew itynnat;
Jingsuh-sieng na u kim Jukut,
Wat la da ki wah duid kin rngat.
Marwei hi u long kper syntiew,
Ha la i jong teijaka;
U pyn'iapngiah la khmat ki briew,
la kat kiba wan poi shata.
Napoh ki liiut ba rben hangta,
U sei !a la ka jong ka khlieh;
U pynshad la ki khmat thaba.
Ban peit i u ngap ne thapbalieh-
Baroh la u te ki fiiew beifi,
Ym don ba kynmaw sngi satia;
Ki niew ba dei tang u hint kein,
Kumta !a u kim da salia.
U long syntiew ba la kheifl poh.
Bad ba la isih da ki briew;
Mynha kito ki sngi baroh,
Katba dang ngen hapoh dymmiew.
Haba syntiew na u la mih,
Napoh kita ki niut ba jrong;
Baroh te la u ki kwah khmih.
Ban kheit la v ki la beh thong.
Mynta ki shem ha lade hi,
Marwei ha la shimet-shinaet;
Ba la u syntiew Langkati,
Da lei lei ngin ym bit ban klet.
PHUD STEW
la nga la jer Phud Stew,

Da u ba rim ba jah ;
Ba hadien kin pyrthew,
Ym bit ba kin saitlah.
Nga long tang i wah duid,
Ba laid na syndah shnong;
Ha saw alom nga tuid,
Jingthung kin ym tyrkhong.
Ki briew ka shnong baroh,
Ki peit da jinglyngngoh ;
Namar ngam ju shongthait,
Man la ka khyllip mat.
